seasonalNotes: Cold dry winters (Dec–Feb, −10°C Seoul). Cherry blossoms late Mar–Apr. Monsoon (장마) late Jun–Jul. Hot humid summers. Autumn foliage late Sep–Nov.

personas.name: Seoul Work & Dinner
personas.description: Works at a startup in Gangnam, lives in Hapjeong. Metro commute, specialty coffee, team lunch, and K-BBQ with friends in Hongdae.

stops.title: T-money card + mask
stops.description: Dust season: check AQI. Top up T-money at the CU.
stops.action: Check AQI and wear a mask if needed. Top up your T-money card at the convenience store.
stops.context: Dust levels can be high in spring—monitor air quality apps.
stops.wellbeing: Wear a KF94 mask for best protection.
stops.motivation: A healthy start means a productive day!
stops.localization: Most convenience stores accept cards and cash.
stops.transition: Walk to Fritz Coffee for your morning brew.
stops.feedback: Did this tip help you start your commute safely?

stops.title: Coffee at Fritz
stops.description: Get the einspänner. ₩6,500 but worth it.
stops.action: Order the einspänner and try a pastry. You may receive a discount for using a reusable cup.
stops.context: Fritz is popular—expect a queue after 8:30 AM.
stops.motivation: A good coffee fuels your creativity!
stops.localization: Staff speak some English. Card payments accepted.
stops.transition: Take the metro to Gangnam for work.
stops.feedback: Did this coffee tip help you enjoy your morning?

stops.title: Sprint standup — don't be late
stops.description: 10 AM sharp. Team lead is strict.
stops.action: Arrive 5 minutes early and check your agenda.
stops.context: Punctuality is highly valued in Korean workplaces.
stops.wellbeing: Take a few deep breaths before the meeting.
stops.transition: Plan for team lunch after the meeting.
stops.feedback: Did this standup tip help you stay on time?

stops.title: Team lunch — samgyeopsal
stops.description: New place on Naver Map. Try the doenjang-jjigae too.
stops.action: Try the samgyeopsal and ask for side dishes. Share with your team.
stops.context: Lunch spots fill up quickly—arrive early for a table.
stops.wellbeing: Eat slowly and enjoy the company.
stops.motivation: Bonding over food builds strong teams!
stops.localization: Menus in Korean, some English available.
stops.transition: Return to the office or run errands nearby.
stops.feedback: Did this lunch tip help you enjoy your meal?

stops.title: Pick up Coupang package at CU
stops.description: Delivery arrived at the CU locker.
stops.action: Bring your pickup code and ID. Use the self-service locker.
stops.context: Evenings are busy at convenience stores.
stops.wellbeing: Sanitize your hands after handling packages.
stops.motivation: Efficient errands free up your evening!
stops.transition: Head to Hongdae for dinner with friends.
stops.feedback: Did this pickup tip help you today?

stops.title: K-BBQ with friends — Hongdae
stops.description: Reservation at 7:30 PM. Don't be late.
stops.action: Arrive on time and order your favorite cuts. Try grilling garlic for extra flavor.
stops.context: Hongdae is lively at night—expect crowds and music.
stops.wellbeing: Eat slowly and drink water with your meal.
stops.localization: Menus in Korean and English. Card payments accepted.
stops.transition: Plan your route home or to your next stop.
stops.feedback: Did this dinner tip help you enjoy your evening?

personas.name: Busan Day Trip
personas.tagline: Fish market, beach, and temple by the sea
personas.description: A day in Busan: Jagalchi sashimi, Haeundae Beach walk, seaside temple, BIFF street food, and Gamcheon Village sunset.

stops.title: Sashimi breakfast at Jagalchi
stops.description: 2nd floor. Pick your fish, they prep it live.
stops.action: Arrive early for the freshest catch. Bring cash for small vendors.
stops.context: Jagalchi is busiest after 9 AM—go early for a quieter experience.
stops.wellbeing: Wash your hands before eating sashimi.
stops.motivation: Start your day with a taste of Busan!
stops.localization: Vendors speak basic English. Card payments accepted at some stalls.
stops.transition: Take the metro to Haeundae Beach.
stops.feedback: Did this breakfast tip help you enjoy Busan?

stops.title: Haeundae Beach walk
stops.description: Boardwalk stroll. Grab a hotteok from the stall.
stops.action: Walk along the boardwalk and try a hotteok from a local vendor.
stops.context: The beach is busiest in summer—visit early for a peaceful stroll.
stops.motivation: A beach walk refreshes your mind!
stops.transition: Take a taxi or bus to Haedong Yonggungsa Temple.
stops.feedback: Did this walk help you enjoy Busan’s coast?

stops.title: Haedong Yonggungsa Temple
stops.description: Temple on ocean cliffs. Stunning views.
stops.action: Walk the cliffside path and take photos of the temple and sea.
stops.context: The temple is a popular spot for both locals and tourists.
stops.wellbeing: Hold the handrail on stairs and watch your step.
stops.localization: Signage in Korean, English, Chinese, Japanese.
stops.transition: Return to the city for lunch at BIFF Square.
stops.feedback: Did this temple tip help you enjoy the view?

stops.title: BIFF Square street food
stops.description: Hotteok, tteokbokki, fried shrimp. Cheap and amazing.
stops.action: Try a variety of street foods and take photos of the BIFF sign.
stops.context: Afternoons are less crowded than evenings.
stops.wellbeing: Eat freshly cooked food for safety.
stops.motivation: Street food is a must in Busan!
stops.localization: Vendors speak some English. Card payments accepted.
stops.transition: Take a bus or taxi to Gamcheon Village.
stops.feedback: Did this food tip help you enjoy Busan?

stops.title: Gamcheon Village sunset
stops.description: Colorful hillside village. Find the Little Prince statue.
stops.action: Explore the village and take photos at sunset. Look for the Little Prince statue.
stops.context: The village is hilly—wear comfortable shoes.
stops.wellbeing: Stay hydrated and take breaks on steep climbs.
stops.motivation: End your day with art and color!
stops.localization: Maps available at the entrance. Cafés and shops throughout.
stops.transition: Plan your route back to Busan Station.
stops.feedback: Did this sunset tip help you enjoy Gamcheon?
